description: Evaluating a class is body code of the body the class is written in: a decorator, the heritage expression, a static field initializer, a `static {}` block and a computed member key all run when control passes the declaration. Only a class written at module level is module evaluation — and a `try` around the declaration bridges exactly what the declaration runs.
